narrative:
Short impact summary

Higher Education in the Era of the Fourth Industrial Revolution (2018), published by Springer Nature, has been cited 488 times — enough that OpenAlex puts it in the top 1% of works in its field and year. Beyond that, it has been downloaded 35,020 times.

Full narrative

Higher Education in the Era of the Fourth Industrial Revolution by Nancy W. Gleason was published by Springer Nature in 2018. Conceptually, the work connects to Industrial Revolution, History, Political science, Engineering ethics and Engineering.

OpenAlex records 488 citations. That places it in the top 1% of works in its field and year of publication. Citations peaked in 2020 with 81 citing works. Notable citing venues include Integration of Education, NWU self-directed learning series and Sustainability. Of 52 citation statements scite has classified, 2 support its claims, 44 mention it in passing, and none contradict it. The citing works include 296 journal articles, 79 book chapters and 16 reviews. They come from 40 countries, led by Indonesia, South Africa and Russia.

It has been downloaded 35,020 times via OAPEN. Open Library reports a combined count of 4 reading logs and catalog editions.
